motivation: Land a rollout the release scripts generated: image digests, source-commit annotations, and the migrate Job named for that commit. A rollout deploys what is on chuggy main; nothing in a brief names a commit or a digest.
acceptanceCriteria: The diff is script output and nothing else, every manifest in it names one source commit, and scripts/check-release-consistency accepts cluster/apps.
constraints: Resolve chuggy main yourself at run time: git ls-remote https://github.com/kasofsk/chuggy.git refs/heads/main. The brief cannot know it.

Digests come only from recorded build results under results/<repository>/<commit>/<request>/, rendered with scripts/render-image-promotion --build-result; never from a registry read or a hand edit. A commit with no result under results/ is a rollout that cannot be produced yet: say so and stop.
Do not reconcile Flux, apply manifests, restart infrastructure, reset data, or deploy. main is live; the pull request you open is the deployment decision and it is the owner's.

instructions: Produce the rollout with the release scripts, and change nothing they did not write.
